data.body: PFMLPB-34526 was selected from the MA PFML readiness assessment in ~/ma-pfml-accessibility-plan as the strongest implementation candidate without a pull request. It was clarified into pilot ticket ff34-7786-fef6-4252 in ~/adp-pilot-tickets with four declared files, five verify commands, and a PendingPeriodsWithReview Storybook story, so a Playwright and vision-model comparison could check for visual regressions without a MyMassGov login.
